title: FluentAI Practice Exercise Schema
description: Schema for deterministic practice exercises tied to vocabulary, grammar, and reading/listening content.

id.description: Stable semantic content identifier, e.g. exercise.vocab.deliberation-01

target_content_id.description: Semantic ID of the vocabulary item or grammar lesson being practiced

prompt_en.description: Instruction for the learner in English

prompt_tr_hint.description: Optional Turkish hint available on demand

stem.description: Question sentence or context with '___' indicating the blank

options.description: Choices for multiple-choice or matching exercises (typically 3-4 options)

correct_answer.description: The exact correct response string or matching answer

explanation_en.description: English feedback explaining why the answer is correct

explanation_tr.description: Turkish feedback explaining grammatical or lexical logic and trap avoidance

distractor_explanations.description: Explanation for why specific wrong answers are incorrect, keyed by the distractor option

difficulty.description: Relative difficulty within the CEFR band
